# COLLADA static fixture

CC0, authored for this repository from the Khronos COLLADA 1.4.1 schema. A centimetre/Z-up scene contains three triangle instances, two shared mesh/material bindings, distinct equal-valued material IDs, ordered node transforms, and an authored matrix.

Supported: static triangles, polylist and hole-free polygons, POSITION/NORMAL/TEXCOORD/COLOR, hierarchy, instance_node, instance_geometry, unit/up-axis conversion, COMMON diffuse/emission/opacity and 2D diffuse images. Controllers, animation, lights/cameras, unsupported accessor layouts and material channels that cannot be represented faithfully are explicit refusals.
